bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small bag to shows. Large bags, backpacks and water bottles are not allowed, and there is no coat check, so plan ahead.
bagPolicy.quote: We allow guests to bring in a small bag for shows. This policy may change at the discretion of management.

parking.summary: There are a few parking ramps near the venue, but Underground Music Venue strongly suggests getting a ride or using Uber or Lyft instead.
parking.quote: There are a few ramps near the venue for parking but we highly suggest getting a ride or Uber/Lyft!

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends Uber or Lyft over driving. No pickup zone is published, so set your pickup to 408 3rd Ave N, or walk a block from the exit after the show so your driver can reach you.
rideshare.quote: There are a few ramps near the venue for parking but we highly suggest getting a ride or Uber/Lyft!

concessions.summary: Underground serves drinks, and a small food menu is offered during the Wednesday and Thursday happy hour from 5 to 7pm. Water bottles are not allowed inside.
concessions.quote: Every Wednesday & Thursday from 5 - 7 PM we offer a small food menu and drinks

accessibility.summary: Underground Music Venue hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Underground Music Venue hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: No one under 18 is admitted unless the event is listed as all ages, and 21+ events are 21+ even with a parent. Bring a valid photo ID such as a driver's license, state ID, passport, tribal ID or military ID. The venue has a firm 12am curfew.
ticketPickup.quote: unless it is specifically stated as an all ages event, no one under 18 is allowed at Underground Music Venue

gates.summary: Underground Music Venue hasn't published entry and doors details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
